One platform, five roles, zero guesswork

Each participant sees only what they need to act: donors post fast, NGOs claim what fits, volunteers carry it, admins keep things safe.

Donors: post in one tap

Repeat a past donation, or speak a description, portions and pickup-by time. Edit extracted values before you publish.

NGOs: claim what fits

See eligible nearby donations with plain-language match reasons, claim all or part within a short confirmation window.

Volunteers: toggle and go

Mark availability and carrying capacity, accept a pickup, and confirm collection and handover with a single tap.

Admins: approve and watch

Approve or suspend participants, monitor active rescues and resolve failed assignments before food is at risk.
